channel.title: Project Planar Player's Guide
channel.description: Last 10 notes on Project Planar Player's Guide

item.title: 470 The Ascendant Gods
item.description: 470 · The Ascendant Gods Mortals who performed the ascension and became gods.

item.title: 472 Orcus
item.description: 472 · Orcus Orcus is the ascendant god of Death.

item.title: 473 Hekate
item.description: 473 · Hekate Hekate is the ascendant god of Magic.

item.title: 474 Afthor
item.description: 474 · Afthor Afthor is the Storm Lord, a storm giant and the largest of the six titans. Kleipur gave him his power at the beginning.

item.title: 475 Thalia
item.description: 475 · Thalia Thalia is the ascendant god of Song. She is earthborn, and she carries a lyre that Atris, the archfey of Hunt, gave her.

item.title: 476 Septimus
item.description: 476 · Septimus Septimus is the devil of Rebellion. He was an Omen and a paladin of Archon, and he tried to take the heavens by force.

item.title: 477 Cleome
item.description: 477 · Cleome Cleome is the ascendant god of Friendship. She is an elf, and a spider orchid grows from her head and through her hair.

item.title: 478 Chore
item.description: 478 · Chore Chore is the Pirate Queen, the ascendant god of Pirates.

item.title: 479 Nausicaä
item.description: 479 · Nausicaä Nausicaä protects children nobody wanted. She was one of them. Her family gave her away young, to an aunt who raised her as a tool.

item.title: 480 Isadora
item.description: 480 · Isadora Isadora is the ascendant god of Luck, fortune and misfortune both, and she plays with fate the way a cat plays with a ball of yarn.
